acceptanceCriteria: host-adapter-test passes -timeout $(GO_TEST_TIMEOUT) to go test (and any other gate-reachable go test target lacking it does too).
A check or test keeps gate-reachable go test invocations in the Makefile bound by GO_TEST_TIMEOUT.
body: Confirmed 2026-10-17: V1-0414 full-gate (make gate, attempt e9a499d1, tree 6bec4548, corvint build 615, load ~45) exited 2 after 11 min: Makefile target host-adapter-test runs `go test -count=1 ./cmd/corvint -run '^(TestDogfoodEvent|...|TestPi)'` with no -timeout, and `panic: test timed out after 10m0s` (FAIL cmd/corvint 601.766s). Decision 0082 / AGENTS.md set GO_TEST_TIMEOUT=30m as the per-package hang detector because 600s is too tight for cmd/corvint. Expected: host-adapter-test uses -timeout $(GO_TEST_TIMEOUT). The same run also had TestHostAdapterJavaScriptHosts/GOC-V0-008 fail under load (leader.pid ENOENT; see V1-0849 umbrella). Evidence blob .git/taskman/evidence/470674c5515e689f6874aff7f2a3f6f4262a9563b5b7ce974594b2a59bf8f8b9.
title: make gate host-adapter-test runs go test ./cmd/corvint without -timeout, so it panics at Go's 10m default under load
